text:
[{"word":"wet","pronun":"[wet]","translation":"n. 雨天；湿气
adj. [气象][物] 潮湿的；有雨的
vt. 弄湿
vi. 变湿","audio":"wet.mp3"},{"word":"wood","pronun":"[wʊd]","translation":"n. 木材；木制品；树林
vt. 植林于；给…添加木柴
vi. 收集木材","audio":"wood.mp3"},{"word":"act","pronun":"[ækt]","translation":"n. 行为，行动；法令，法案；（戏剧，歌剧的）一幕，段；装腔作势
vt. 扮演；装作，举动像
vi. 行动；扮演，充当；表现，举止；假装，演戏；起作用，见效","audio":"act.mp3"},{"word":"actor","pronun":"[ˈæktər]","translation":"n. 男演员；行动者；作用物","audio":"actor.mp3"},{"word":"actress","pronun":"[ˈæktrəs]","translation":"n. 女演员","audio":"actress.mp3"},{"word":"ballet","pronun":"[bæˈleɪ]","translation":"n. 芭蕾舞剧；芭蕾舞乐曲","audio":"ballet.mp3"},{"word":"box office","pronun":"","translation":"n. 票房；售票处","audio":"box_office.mp3"},{"word":"cartoon","pronun":"[kɑːrˈtuːn]","translation":"n. 卡通片，[电影] 动画片；连环漫画
vt. 为…画漫画
vi. 画漫画","audio":"cartoon.mp3"},{"word":"character","pronun":"[ˈkærəktər]","translation":"n. 性格，品质；特性；角色；[计] 字符
vt. 印，刻；使具有特征","audio":"character.mp3"},{"word":"clap","pronun":"[klæp]","translation":"n. 鼓掌；拍手声
vt. 拍手，鼓掌；轻轻拍打某人
vi. 鼓掌，拍手；啪地关上","audio":"clap.mp3"},{"word":"classical","pronun":"[ˈklæsɪkl]","translation":"n. 古典音乐
adj. 古典的；经典的；传统的；第一流的","audio":"classical.mp3"},{"word":"pop","pronun":"[pɑːp]","translation":"abbr. 卖点广告（Point of Purchase）","audio":"pop.mp3"},{"word":"rock music","pronun":"","translation":"un. 摇滚音乐","audio":"rock_music.mp3"},{"word":"comedy","pronun":"[ˈkɑːmədi]","translation":"n. 喜剧；喜剧性；有趣的事情","audio":"comedy.mp3"},{"word":"concert","pronun":"[ˈkɑːnsərt]","translation":"n. 音乐会；一致；和谐
adj. 音乐会用的；在音乐会上演出的
vt. 使协调；协同安排
vi. 协调；协力","audio":"concert.mp3"},{"word":"dance","pronun":"[dæns]","translation":"n. 舞蹈；舞会；舞曲
adj. 舞蹈的；用于跳舞的
vt. 跳舞；使跳跃
vi. 跳舞；跳跃；飘扬","audio":"dance.mp3"},{"word":"drama","pronun":"[ˈdrɑːmə]","translation":"n. 戏剧，戏剧艺术；剧本；戏剧性事件","audio":"drama.mp3"},{"word":"drum","pronun":"[drʌm]","translation":"n. 鼓；鼓声
vi. 击鼓；大力争取
vt. 击鼓；大力争取","audio":"drum.mp3"},{"word":"exhibition","pronun":"[ˌeksɪˈbɪʃn]","translation":"n. 展览，显示；展览会；展览品","audio":"exhibition.mp3"},{"word":"film","pronun":"[fɪlm]","translation":"n. 电影；薄膜；胶卷；轻烟
vt. 在…上覆以薄膜；把…拍成电影
vi. 摄制电影；生薄膜；变得朦胧","audio":"film.mp3"}]
